title: Hookd-No Spread, No Recoil, No Bullet Drop, Aimbot, ESP
features:
Combat

Aimbot

Enable/disable aimbot
Can target shooting-range dummies
Target part: Head / UpperTorso / HumanoidRootPart
Target priority: Crosshair / Distance / Health
FOV origin: Center / Cursor
Ignore teammates
Visibility check
Sticky/keep-current-target targeting
FOV circle
Adjustable FOV
Adjustable smoothing, including snap at 0
Maximum targeting distance
Prediction

Aimbot activation & tracking

Hold / Toggle / Always activation modes
MouseButton1, MouseButton2, LeftAlt, Q, or E binds
Ignore protected/ForceField targets
Vertical movement prediction
Lock grace period
Deadzone
Minimum target health
Maximum prediction distance
Range slack
Turn-speed cap

Silent Aim

Enable silent aim
Head / UpperTorso / HumanoidRootPart targeting
Crosshair / Distance / Health selection
Visibility check
Ignore teammates
Silent-aim FOV circle
Adjustable FOV
Maximum range
Adjustable hit chance from 0–100%

Ragebot / Rage Targeting

Enable rage targeting
Configurable hold bind
Adjustable target-switch interval
Adjustable targeting range
Head / UpperTorso / HumanoidRootPart targeting
Selection by Crosshair / Distance / Health
Switch modes:
On elimination
Timed
Nearest
Visibility check
Ignore teammates
Silent rage targeting
Auto-fire while rage is held
Adjustable auto-fire rate cap
Target cycling/selection logic

One important detail: the script itself explicitly notes that server damage validation still applies. So this isn't coded as a guaranteed "one-shot through any wall" system.

ESP

It has:

Enable ESP
Skeleton ESP
Outline ESP
Both skeleton + outline
Ignore teammates
Through-walls display
Names
Health
Distance
Four color choices: Ice, Violet, Rose, Lime
Adjustable ESP range
Adjustable line thickness
Weapon features

It includes:

Zero recoil
Zero spread
Faster fire rate
Adjustable fire-rate multiplier
Faster reload
Adjustable reload multiplier

There's also a weapon skin changer. It detects the currently equipped weapon, finds compatible skins, saves a skin separately for each weapon, and reapplies saved choices after re-equipping/respawning.

Movement

There's an entire Movement tab with:

Walk-speed multiplier
Walk multiplier from 1×–10×
Fly
Adjustable fly speed
Shift fly-speed boost
Configurable fly toggle key
Noclip
Configurable noclip key

Fly uses WASD, Space to move upward, Ctrl to move downward, and Shift for the configured speed boost.

The movement code also restores collision and movement state when features are disabled/unloaded.

Visuals

Chinese Hat

Local-only Chinese hat
First-person visibility toggle
Adjustable radius
Adjustable height
Adjustable head offset
Adjustable hue/color
Adjustable glow

World visuals

Ambience override
Ambient hue
Indoor ambience level
Outdoor ambience level
Bloom
Bloom intensity
Bloom size
Bloom threshold
Custom skybox
Separate asset IDs for all six skybox faces
Reset-world-effects button

These changes are designed to be local and restored when unloaded.

Configs & UI

It also has a pretty complete configuration system:

Automatically saves changes
Automatically loads the last profile
Named profiles
Save profile
Load profile
List profiles
Reset current config
Saved weapon skins
Menu scaling
Glass/menu transparency
Recenter window
Unload-and-restore button
Right Shift menu toggle
Draggable window
